findings.title: Arbitrary code execution via unpinned model weights deserialised with torch.load
findings.description: The two ensemble checkpoints are absent from the repository (.gitignore excludes *.pth) and are fetched by hand from consumer Google Drive links recorded in source-pth. torch.load is called without weights_only=True, so a substituted archive executes attacker-controlled pickle opcodes in the Flask process during module import, before any request is served.

vulnerability_root_cause.code_snippet:
model_a.load_state_dict(torch.load(MODEL_PATH_A, map_location=device))
        model_a.to(device).eval()
        target_layer_a = model_a.features[-1]

        model_b = models.efficientnet_b3(weights=None)
        model_b.classifier[1] = nn.Linear(model_b.classifier[1].in_features, NUM_CLASSES)
        model_b.load_state_dict(torch.load(MODEL_PATH_B, map_location=device))
vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: torch.load defaults to full pickle deserialisation. Because the weight artefacts live outside version control on a shared consumer file host with no digest, no signature and no integrity check at load time, the trust boundary for remote code execution is whoever can write to that Drive link.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: enforce_safe_weight_load
trigger: tool_call_name: load_ensemble
condition: torch_load_weights_only != true OR sha256(artifact) not in allowlist
action: block

reproduction_steps: Craft a .pth whose pickle stream contains a __reduce__ returning os.system.
Place it at best_model_convnext.pth as a user following README setup would.
Start the app; the payload executes at import time via load_ensemble.

findings.title: Werkzeug interactive debugger enabled on a service handling patient imaging
findings.description: app.run(debug=True) exposes the Werkzeug debugger. Any reachable traceback page offers an evaluation console, converting a routine 500 into unauthenticated remote code execution on the host that processes and stores X-ray uploads.

vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: Debug mode is hardcoded rather than read from an environment variable, so the same entrypoint used in development is the one a user follows from the README. There is no production configuration path that disables it.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: forbid_debug_server
trigger: finding_type: DEBUG_MODE_ENABLED
action: block

reproduction_steps: POST a malformed file to /predict to raise an unhandled error outside the try block.
Observe the Werkzeug traceback page and its interactive console affordance.

findings.title: Radiographic findings are fabricated from the class label, not observed in the image
findings.description: MEDICAL_CODES maps each of the four labels to fixed prose asserting specific measured anatomy the system never measures. A misalignment prediction always reports 'Translational displacement >3mm observed'; a fracture prediction always reports 'Cortical disruption noted with trabecular compression'. The text is a dictionary lookup on the argmax label and is identical for every patient who receives that label.

vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: The model emits a 4-way label and nothing else. Every quantitative clinical claim in the report is therefore invented downstream and presented in the grammatical voice of direct observation, which makes an unverifiable model guess indistinguishable from a radiologist's measurement.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: forbid_unmeasured_quantitative_claims
trigger: finding_type: FABRICATED_CLINICAL_EVIDENCE
action: block

reproduction_steps: Submit two anatomically different images that both classify as misalignment.
Compare the FINDINGS block in each report; the >3mm displacement claim is byte-identical.

findings.title: Named drug regimens written into a signed report with no clinician gate
findings.description: TREATMENT_PLANS supplies specific pharmacological advice per label, including Calcitonin, Bisphosphonates, NSAIDs, muscle relaxants and epidural steroid injections, and generatePDF writes it into a letterhead document that saves directly to disk. There is no confirmation dialog, no clinician review step and no reversal path once the file exists.

vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: Prescribing guidance is selected by the same dictionary key as the diagnosis, so a single misclassification propagates unchecked into a medication recommendation. The only human checkpoint in the design is a blank 'Verified by' line printed after the advice has already been rendered and saved.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: hitl_before_clinical_report
trigger: tool_call_name: generate_pdf_report
action: interrupt
requires: licensed_clinician_approval

reproduction_steps: Upload any image that classifies as fracture.
Click Download Report; a PDF prescribing Calcitonin and Bisphosphonates is written to disk with no approval step.

findings.title: Patient identifier fabricated with Math.random on a diagnostic document
findings.description: generatePDF prints 'Patient ID: <8 random digits>' on a report headed NEUROSPINE DIAGNOSTIC CENTER with a street address and phone number. The identifier is not drawn from any patient record, is not collision-free, and cannot be reconciled against a medical record system, while looking authoritative on a document formatted as a clinical record.

vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: The report template requires a patient identity field that the application never collects, so it is synthesised at render time. Two reports for the same patient receive different IDs and two different patients may receive the same one.

reproduction_steps: Generate two reports from the identical uploaded image.
Observe two different Patient IDs on documents describing the same study.

findings.title: ICD-10-CM billing codes assigned automatically from a CNN argmax
findings.description: Each label carries a fixed billable code, including M48.50XA for acute vertebral compression fracture. The code is rendered in the results panel and the PDF with no coder, clinician or documentation check, so a model error becomes a coded claim asserting an acute injury that was never diagnosed by a person.

vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: Diagnosis and reimbursement coding are collapsed into one dictionary entry, so there is no place in the design where a code could be reviewed independently of the prediction that produced it. The 7th-character extension XA further asserts an initial encounter for acute injury, a temporal claim the model cannot make.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: hitl_before_billing_code
trigger: tool_call_name: assign_icd10_code
action: interrupt
requires: certified_coder_approval

reproduction_steps: Submit a chronic degenerative study that the ensemble misclassifies as fracture.
Observe M48.50XA rendered as the ICD-10 code in both the UI and the PDF.

findings.title: No confidence floor and no abstention path
findings.description: torch.max over the averaged softmax vector is returned unconditionally. A near-uniform distribution (maximum probability around 0.26 across four classes) produces the same categorical diagnosis, the same findings text and the same treatment plan as a 0.99 prediction, with a Grad-CAM++ overlay alongside that lends it the appearance of localisation evidence.

vulnerability_root_cause.code_snippet:
with torch.no_grad():
            out_a = model_a(img_tensor)
            out_b = model_b(img_tensor)
            probs = (torch.softmax(out_a, 1) + torch.softmax(out_b, 1)) / 2
            prob_vector = probs[0]
            confidence, predicted_index = torch.max(prob_vector, 0)
            predicted_class = CLASS_LABELS[predicted_index.item()]
vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: The confidence value is computed and returned but never gates anything. There is no threshold below which the service declines to diagnose, no out-of-distribution check for non-spinal or non-radiographic input, and no path that returns 'insufficient confidence' instead of a class.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: abstain_below_confidence_floor
trigger: ensemble_confidence < 0.70
action: inject_disclaimer
fallback: suppress_diagnosis_and_treatment_plan

reproduction_steps: Upload a non-spinal photograph.
Observe a definitive spinal diagnosis, ICD-10 code and treatment plan derived from a near-uniform probability vector.

findings.title: Unauthenticated patient imaging ingress with no rate limit or audit trail
findings.description: POST /predict accepts any multipart file from any origin with no authentication, authorisation, CSRF token, rate limit or audit log. The only file-type restriction is the accept attribute on the HTML input, which is advisory and absent from any direct HTTP client.

vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: The route has no decorator or middleware establishing identity, so there is no subject to authorise, no principal to log and no per-caller budget to enforce. Health imaging is special-category data under GDPR Article 9 and the endpoint records nothing about who submitted it.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: require_authenticated_phi_upload
trigger: finding_type: UNAUTHENTICATED_PHI_INGRESS
action: block
requires: authenticated_principal AND audit_log_entry

reproduction_steps: curl -F file=@xray.png http://127.0.0.1:5000/predict with no credentials.
Receive a full diagnosis; confirm no audit record identifies the caller.

findings.title: Raw exception strings returned to the HTTP client
findings.description: The catch-all handler serialises str(e) into the JSON error response, disclosing absolute filesystem paths, tensor shapes, CUDA state and library internals to any unauthenticated caller, and providing a probe oracle for the deserialisation and resource-exhaustion findings.

vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: A single broad except returns the exception text verbatim rather than a correlation id, so internal state is the default error surface. Combined with the silent model-load failure this is also how a completely non-functional deployment presents itself to callers.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: sanitise_error_bodies
trigger: regex:(Traceback|torch\.|CUDA)
action: sanitise
replace_with: correlation_id_only

reproduction_steps: POST a truncated PNG to /predict.
Read the JSON error field and observe PIL internals and local paths.

findings.title: Unsanitised label crossing the service boundary drives all downstream clinical content
findings.description: The backend returns predicted_class as a bare string which the browser uses directly as a dictionary key to select findings, impression, ICD-10 code and medication. There is no schema validation, allow-list check or integrity binding on the crossing, so whatever the inference service emits is treated as authoritative clinical fact by the report composer.

vulnerability_root_cause.code_snippet:
return jsonify({
            'predicted_class': predicted_class,
            'confidence': confidence.item(),
            'all_probabilities': prob_dict,
            'heatmap_image': f"data:image/png;base64,{heatmap_b64}",
            'graph_image': f"data:image/png;base64,{graph_b64}"
        })
vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: The trust relationship between the inference service and the report composer is implicit. predicted_class is lowercased and used as a lookup key with no validation that it is one of the four expected labels, and the resulting objects are written into the DOM through innerHTML, so control of the response body is control of the rendered clinical report.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: validate_inference_response
trigger: finding_type: TOOL_OUTPUT_INJECTION
action: sanitise
requires: predicted_class in CLASS_LABELS AND textContent_not_innerHTML

reproduction_steps: Intercept the /predict response and alter predicted_class from normal to fracture.
Observe the composer emit acute fracture findings, M48.50XA and a Bisphosphonate regimen.

findings.title: Report-generating scripts loaded from a CDN without Subresource Integrity
findings.description: jsPDF and jspdf-autotable are pulled from cdnjs with no integrity attribute and no crossorigin pinning. The code that composes, signs and saves clinical PDFs is therefore whatever the CDN serves at request time.

vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: Without an integrity digest the browser cannot detect substituted script content, and the substituted code would run with full access to currentData, which holds the diagnosis, confidence vector and both rendered images for the current study.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: require_sri_on_external_scripts
trigger: finding_type: MISSING_SUBRESOURCE_INTEGRITY
action: block

reproduction_steps: Serve a modified jspdf.umd.min.js through an intercepting proxy.
Confirm the page executes it without complaint and the substituted code can read currentData.

findings.title: Unbounded upload read into memory and decoded by PIL
findings.description: No MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH is configured and no pixel-dimension bound is applied. The entire request body is read into memory and handed to PIL.Image.open, so a decompression bomb or a large file exhausts memory and takes the diagnostic service offline for all users.

vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: file.read() with no size guard, followed by convert('RGB') and np.array, materialises the fully decompressed bitmap three times over. A small crafted PNG can therefore demand gigabytes, and CLAHE then runs another full-resolution pass before any resize occurs.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: cap_upload_size_and_dimensions
trigger: content_length > 10485760 OR decoded_pixels > 25000000
action: block

reproduction_steps: POST a 90000x90000 single-colour PNG of a few hundred kilobytes.
Observe memory growth and loss of service for concurrent callers.

findings.title: Model load failure is swallowed, leaving the service running with no model
findings.description: load_ensemble catches every exception, prints it and returns four Nones which are assigned to the module-level handles. The process starts and reports itself healthy while model_a is None, and the failure only surfaces later as a generic 500 on each request, hiding the fact that no inference is possible from anyone reading startup output casually.

vulnerability_root_cause.code_snippet:
except Exception as e:
        print(f"\u274c Error: {e}")
        return None, None, None, None

model_a, model_b, cam_a, cam_b = load_ensemble()
vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: A missing or corrupt checkpoint, the default state for a fresh clone since the weights are gitignored and must be fetched from Drive by hand, produces a running server rather than a startup failure. There is no readiness probe that distinguishes loaded from unloaded, so a deployment can be advertised as available while structurally incapable of diagnosing anything.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: fail_closed_on_model_load
trigger: finding_type: SILENT_MODEL_LOAD_FAILURE
action: block
requires: raise_on_load_error AND readiness_probe_reflects_model_state

reproduction_steps: Clone the repository without fetching the two Drive checkpoints and start the app.
Observe the server binds port 5000 successfully, then returns a 500 with a NoneType error for every /predict call.

findings.title: Automated output carries an electronic signature attestation
findings.description: The PDF footer reads 'Electronically signed by AI Assistant. Verified by __________________' on a document bearing a clinic name, address and phone number. This attaches signature-like authority to output no person has reviewed, and the blank verification line implies a review workflow the application does not implement.

vulnerability_root_cause.root_cause_analysis: The phrase 'Electronically signed' has specific meaning in clinical documentation, denoting attribution to a licensed individual. Applying it to unreviewed model output misrepresents the provenance of every claim above it in the same document.

suggested_guardrail.yaml_rule_stanza:
rule: replace_ai_signature_with_disclaimer
trigger: string_match: Electronically signed by AI Assistant
action: inject_disclaimer
text: RESEARCH PREVIEW - NOT A DIAGNOSTIC DEVICE - NOT REVIEWED BY A CLINICIAN

reproduction_steps: Generate any report and read the footer on the final page.
